name: Melanie Candy
story: Taranaki Regional Council’s Transforming Taranaki publication identifies Melanie Candy as a GIS officer working on riparian plans. The council used mapping and aerial photography to plan streamside protection on farms.
The council's November 2011 programme booklet shows Melanie Candy updating a riparian plan, with aerial mapping on screen and paper.
